grok.performance_metric: assets retained; GCI segment revenue flat ~$970-981M 2021-23
grok.rationale: The slice documents continued operation of the Alaska communications business as Liberty Broadband's separately reported GCI Holdings segment through 2021-2023, with essentially flat-to-rising revenue ($970M to $981M) and Adjusted OIBDA ($354M to $361M) and stable segment assets (~$3.3-3.4B); no product/process misalignment or operating incoherence is described. Regulatory settlement accruals tied to a pre-existing Rural Health Care Program matter are noted but are not framed as product-process or process-organization integration failures. Absence of any documented disruption at those interfaces yields p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0.
